notes: Official Nix 2.31.6 x86_64-linux binary closure, six-path locked input closure, and a sandboxed offline bash printf derivation in a private store. This does not qualify all nixpkgs, compiler bootstrap, or arbitrary derivations.
Method is binary: the official upstream store closure is imported; the package manager itself is not claimed source-built.
Only an isolated local store and private daemon are used. Offline checks fail if user namespaces are denied.
